description: This file defines the React context and provider component for authentication within a frontend application. It manages authentication state, handles login/logout processes via OAuth and API tokens for Jira and Confluence services, and fetches related service data such as projects and spaces. It also provides methods for refresh, error handling, and state management.

methods.name: authReducer
methods.description: Reducer function for managing authentication state based on dispatched actions.

methods.name: checkAuthStatus
methods.description: Checks current authentication status on component mount and fetches service data if authenticated.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login via OAuth or API tokens for specified services, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user and resets the authentication state.

methods.name: clearServiceError
methods.description: Clears error state for a specific service.

methods.name: fetchServiceData
methods.description: Fetches data for a specific service (Jira projects or Confluence spaces).
